messages:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated malloc failure rate and KV-slot arena fragmentation detected on prod-gpu-12 (us-west-2). Errors correlated with continuous-batching traffic spikes. Auto-escalation to oncall.
Alice Rivera: saw the page, connecting to the host now. seeing allocator churn + repeated slab evictions.
Ben Cho: joining — likely the new packer change + longer sequence windows triggered more KV growth. Any active canaries?
Maya Patel: can confirm increased prefix cache miss rate for chat-model-prod-3; token parallelism jumped ~4x 30m ago.
Alice Rivera: `pmap` shows process rss oscillating 9GB -> 18GB before OOM kill attempts. CUDA OOMs in dmesg.
Liam O'Connor: putting customer-facing routing to fallback tier for affected model to reduce pressure. Routing rule applied: `route: chat-prod -> chat-prod-fallback` :white_check_mark:
oncall-sre-bot: Handoff: Alice (eng-oncall) now primary, Ben (eng-runtime) secondary. Escalation level: SEV2.
Alice Rivera: immediate mitigation: disable continuous batching for pool gen-2-small and lower batch_max_tokens to 512. Ben, can you push config?
Ben Cho: doing it now. Pushing hotfix to runtime config store. Command I ran:
```bash
redwoodctl config set /pools/gen-2-small/continuous_batching enabled=false --reason "hotfix: slab thrash"
redwoodctl config set /pools/gen-2-small/batch_max_tokens 512
```
Ben Cho: confirmed change applied to 8/10 hosts, rolling to remainder.
Maya Patel: observing request latency increase on fallback but error rate drop from 4.7% -> 0.8% for chat-prod. Good.
Alice Rivera: next step: trigger arena compaction on affected nodes and rotate allocator arenas to force reuse. Plan: run compaction script & then a staged restart of infer-service on nodes that still show fragmentation > 70%.
Liam O'Connor: I'll coordinate compute drain windows and customer comms. ETA: compaction job starts in 2m.
Ben Cho: compaction command:
```bash
ssh node-prod-12 "sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv_compact --arena=kv_slot --threshold=0.7"
```
Ben Cho: tail of allocator log from node-prod-12 just before compaction:
```
[2026-03-15T09:41:02Z] allocator: arena=kv_slot used=13.4GB free_frag=1.9GB fragments=1243
[2026-03-15T09:41:05Z] runtime: continuous_batching: queued=380 active=12
[2026-03-15T09:41:07Z] cuda: gpu_mem_used=14432MB gpu_mem_free=512MB OOM_warn=1
```
Alice Rivera: compaction kicked off, monitoring memory reclaim. If compaction doesn't drop fragmentation below 40% within 5m, we'll schedule an orderly service restart for those hosts.
oncall-sre-bot: Reminder: take screenshots of dashboards and save logs to incident bucket.
Maya Patel: compaction reduced fragmentation to ~38% on node-prod-12, reclaimed ~4.1GB. Errors on that host dropped immediately.
Ben Cho: continuing rollout of config to the last 2 hosts; also toggled a soft kv-cache cap to 6GB to avoid re-growth while we stabilize.
Alice Rivera: good catch. Liam, please start a brief post to customers in the affected region—note degraded latency and failover, no data lost, mitigation in progress.
Liam O'Connor: posted status update to status.redwood.ai: "We detected a performance regression affecting chat inference in US-WEST-2. Traffic routed to fallback, engineers applying fixes. Some users may see elevated latency; errors decreasing." :loud_sound:
Alice Rivera: root-cause hypothesis for postmortem: allocator arena fragmentation exacerbated by continuous-batching + a recent packer change that lengthened KV prefixes, causing many small slab allocations and preventing coalescing. We'll collect heap profiles and the recent diff for packer.
Ben Cho: saving heap snapshots and `mallinfo` outputs to gs://redwood-incidents/1859123456/
Maya Patel: will run regression replay with and without continuous batching to quantify perf delta and draft regression test.
Alice Rivera: next actions summarized: 1) keep continuous batching disabled for gen-2-small; 2) keep kv soft cap until next deploy; 3) gather profiles + diffs; 4) schedule postmortem tomorrow and assign owner (Ben).
Ben Cho: happy to own postmortem.
Alice Rivera: thanks all. I'll update oncall notes and mark incident as active->mitigated once all nodes pass healthcheck.
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigations applied, monitoring for recurrence.
